estimates.assumptions: 1 celery stalk is typically ~40g edible portion (USDA average for a medium stalk without leaves).
1 sliced leek is estimated at ~90g based on a medium leek's white and light green edible parts (common recipe size; dark green often discarded).
1 medium potato estimated at 170g (typical range 150-200g for a medium baking or all-purpose potato, raw peeled weight).
1 knob of butter is a modest ~15g (standard estimate for a small pat or knob used in sweating vegetables).
1 head of broccoli (chopped) estimated at 250g edible florets and tender stalk (typical medium head after trimming tough stem; full head with stem often 300-400g but recipe separates stalk earlier).
Grams copied from supplied 140g. CaloriesPer100g estimated from typical Stilton blue cheese values (~360-370 kcal/100g); known value was null so realistic average used.
